rationale: Frozen objective is peak_allocated_bytes minimization for one offline batch-32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward on a single CUDA device, subject to images_per_second >= 0.95 of baseline (request.json; workloads.json resnet_inference offline). The torch collector already ran and its coverage is complete and unambiguous: 221 CUDA kernels, all 221 associated with project scopes, 0 unassociated, 0 root-only, 0 backward/autograd ranges (consistent with torch.inference_mode at resnet_inference.py:14-16), and 0 ambiguous forward sequences. Both objective metrics are measured directly by the frozen evaluator (torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats/max_memory_allocated and synchronize-bracketed perf_counter_ns at resnet_inference.py:42-48), so additional collectors are justified only by an open diagnostic question they can actually resolve. No such question exists: (1) communication-side collectors (nccl_tuning, collective_calibration) are inapplicable - observations.json marks communication not_applicable for this single-device task, distributed_backend is null, and no NCCL kernels appear; (2) nsys is available (request.json tools.nsys) but is gated on overlap, graph-tracing or attribution questions, and none remain given complete kernel association, no CUDA graphs, and a single eager stream; (3) execution_timeline would duplicate already-complete CPU-to-CUDA submit association, and its gradient post-accumulate callbacks are irrelevant to inference_mode; (4) device_telemetry provides device-wide NVML readings with native windows that cannot resolve allocator-level peak bytes for one invocation, and PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be invented from payload or memcpy sizes; (5) python_runtime perturbs execution and its cProfile times are not clean scores for a GPU-memory objective whose throughput floor is enforced on clean workers; (6) candidate_diagnostics and binding_cost are inapplicable before any candidate exists, and empty candidate diagnostics would not identify the executed path anyway. Selecting any of these would request counters indiscriminately without resolving evidence. Therefore no additional collectors are requested; the remaining unknown dimensions (notably per-op peak allocation attribution, which no listed collector supplies) are recorded in unavailable_fields with observed reasons and retained as unknown per framework policy.
